name: 3 John
section: New Testament: General Letters and Revelation
author: The author calls himself “the elder.”
setting: Written to Gaius about hospitality for traveling teachers.
theme: Support those who work for the truth.

outline.label: The elder to the beloved Gaius
Diotrephes who loves to be first
Imitate good, and Demetrius is commended

christInBook: John says that the traveling teachers went out for the sake of the name (v. 7). Christ’s name is the reason for hospitality and the center of the mission.
howToRead: 3 John is the most personal of John’s letters. Notice the three people: Gaius, Diotrephes, and Demetrius, and the contrast between hospitality and pride.
